target: Kemarin saya pergi ke pasar dengan ibu saya.
english: Yesterday I went to the market with my mother.
grammar: Time words do the past-tense work: Kemarin saya pergi. = Yesterday I went. The verb never changes.

target: Tadi pagi saya bangun jam enam.
english: This morning I woke up at six.
grammar: tadi = earlier today: tadi pagi = this morning (already past).

target: Minggu lalu kami pergi ke Yogyakarta naik kereta.
english: Last week we went to Yogyakarta by train.

target: Kemarin sore saya bertemu teman lama di kafe.
english: Yesterday afternoon I met an old friend at a cafe.

target: Tadi malam kami makan sate di dekat rumah.
english: Last night we ate satay near the house.

target: Setelah sarapan, saya langsung berangkat ke kantor.
english: After breakfast, I left for the office right away.
grammar: langsung = straight away: langsung berangkat = leave right away.

target: Sebelum tidur, saya menulis rencana untuk besok.
english: Before sleeping, I wrote a plan for tomorrow.

target: Waktu saya kecil, keluarga kami tinggal di desa.
english: When I was little, our family lived in a village.
grammar: waktu opens a past when-clause: Waktu saya kecil... = When I was little...

target: Kemarin dia pulang kerja jam sembilan malam.
english: Yesterday he came home from work at nine at night.

target: Bulan lalu saya mulai belajar bahasa Indonesia.
english: Last month I started learning Indonesian.
grammar: lalu after a time word = last: bulan lalu = last month, minggu lalu = last week.

target: Saya mandi dulu, lalu sarapan dengan keluarga.
english: I showered first, then had breakfast with my family.
grammar: dulu after a verb = first: Saya mandi dulu. = I shower first.

target: Kami masuk museum, kemudian makan siang di taman.
english: We went into the museum, then had lunch in the park.

target: Tadi saya minum kopi, terus lupa membayar.
english: Earlier I drank coffee, and then forgot to pay.
grammar: terus strings actions in speech: ..., terus lupa = ..., and then (I) forgot.

target: Kemarin pagi hujan turun sangat deras.
english: Yesterday morning the rain came down very hard.

target: Setelah rapat selesai, kami makan siang bersama.
english: After the meeting ended, we had lunch together.

target: Sebelum berangkat, dia menutup semua jendela.
english: Before leaving, she closed all the windows.

target: Minggu lalu saya menginap di rumah nenek.
english: Last week I stayed over at grandma's house.
grammar: menginap = stay overnight: menginap di rumah nenek = sleep over at grandma's.

target: Waktu kami tiba, toko itu sudah tutup.
english: When we arrived, the shop was already closed.
grammar: sudah inside a story = already: sudah tutup = was already closed.

target: Kemarin saya lupa membawa dompet ke kantor.
english: Yesterday I forgot to bring my wallet to the office.

target: Tadi pagi kereta datang terlambat tiga puluh menit.
english: This morning the train arrived thirty minutes late.

target: Dua hari lalu kami berenang di pantai.
english: Two days ago we swam at the beach.
grammar: lalu after a time span = ago: dua hari lalu = two days ago.

target: Setelah makan malam, ayah bercerita tentang masa kecilnya.
english: After dinner, dad told stories about his childhood.

target: Saya membeli tiket dulu, kemudian menunggu di peron.
english: I bought a ticket first, then waited on the platform.

target: Kemarin malam kami menonton film Indonesia di rumah.
english: Last night we watched an Indonesian film at home.

target: Tadi siang saya makan bakso di warung sebelah.
english: At midday I ate meatball soup at the food stall next door.

target: Tahun lalu mereka pindah ke Surabaya.
english: Last year they moved to Surabaya.

target: Sebelum pergi, jangan lupa kunci pintu depan.
english: Before going, don't forget to lock the front door.
grammar: jangan lupa = don't forget: Jangan lupa kunci pintu. = Don't forget to lock the door.

target: Waktu hujan turun, kami berteduh di halte bus.
english: When the rain came down, we took shelter at the bus stop.

target: Setelah pulang sekolah, anak-anak bermain di halaman.
english: After coming home from school, the kids played in the yard.

target: Kemarin saya menelepon ibu saya di kampung.
english: Yesterday I called my mother back in the village.

target: Tadi pagi saya jalan kaki ke stasiun.
english: This morning I walked to the station.

target: Minggu lalu bos saya pergi ke Singapura.
english: Last week my boss went to Singapore.

target: Kami berbelanja di pasar, lalu memasak bersama.
english: We shopped at the market, then cooked together.

target: Setelah film selesai, kami langsung pulang.
english: After the film ended, we went straight home.

target: Kemarin sore saya mampir ke rumah teman.
english: Yesterday afternoon I dropped by a friend's house.
grammar: mampir = drop by: mampir ke rumah teman = stop by a friend's place.

target: Waktu saya di Bali, saya belajar sedikit bahasa daerah.
english: When I was in Bali, I learned a bit of the local language.

target: Tadi malam saya tidur larut karena pekerjaan.
english: Last night I went to bed late because of work.

target: Sebelum makan, kami berdoa bersama.
english: Before eating, we prayed together.

target: Dua minggu lalu kami berlibur ke Lombok.
english: Two weeks ago we went on holiday to Lombok.
grammar: berlibur = go on holiday, from libur (day off): berlibur ke Lombok.

target: Setelah itu, kami minum es kelapa di pantai.
english: After that, we drank iced coconut on the beach.
grammar: Setelah itu = after that — the glue between story sentences.

target: Kemarin dia lupa mematikan lampu dapur.
english: Yesterday he forgot to turn off the kitchen light.

target: Tadi pagi saya memberi makan kucing kami.
english: This morning I fed our cat.

target: Waktu kecil, dia sering berenang di sungai.
english: When he was little, he often swam in the river.

target: Setelah kelas selesai, kami minum teh bersama.
english: After class ended, we drank tea together.

target: Kemarin kami menjemput tamu di bandara.
english: Yesterday we picked up guests at the airport.

target: Bulan lalu harga beras naik lagi.
english: Last month the price of rice went up again.

target: Tadi sore anak saya pulang sekolah lebih awal.
english: This afternoon my child came home from school early.

target: Sebelum rapat mulai, saya membaca laporan itu.
english: Before the meeting started, I read the report.

target: Minggu lalu kami mengunjungi kakek di desa.
english: Last week we visited grandpa in the village.

target: Kemarin malam listrik mati selama dua jam.
english: Last night the electricity was out for two hours.
grammar: selama = for (a duration): selama dua jam = for two hours.

target: Saya sakit kepala sejak tadi pagi.
english: I have had a headache since this morning.
grammar: sakit + body part = it hurts: sakit kepala = headache, sakit perut = stomachache.

target: Perut saya sakit setelah makan pedas.
english: My stomach hurts after eating spicy food.

target: Anak saya demam sejak kemarin malam.
english: My child has had a fever since last night.
grammar: sejak = since: sejak kemarin malam = since last night.

target: Kamu harus pergi ke dokter hari ini.
english: You have to go to the doctor today.

target: Saya mau minum obat dulu sebelum tidur.
english: I want to take my medicine first before sleeping.
grammar: minum obat = take medicine — literally 'drink medicine', even for pills.

target: Gigi saya sakit sekali, saya perlu dokter gigi.
english: My tooth really hurts, I need a dentist.

target: Dia tidak masuk kerja karena sakit flu.
english: He did not come to work because he has the flu.

target: Cepat sembuh, ya! Istirahat yang cukup.
english: Get well soon! Get enough rest.
grammar: Cepat sembuh! = Get well soon — the standard sympathy phrase.

target: Ibu membeli obat batuk di apotek.
english: Mom bought cough medicine at the pharmacy.

target: Saya merasa pusing dan mual pagi ini.
english: I feel dizzy and nauseous this morning.

target: Badan saya capek setelah kerja seminggu penuh.
english: My body is worn out after a full week of work.
grammar: capek = tired (everyday speech); lelah is its slightly dressier twin.

target: Tenggorokan saya sakit, susah menelan.
english: My throat hurts, it is hard to swallow.

target: Kaki saya luka karena jatuh dari sepeda.
english: My leg got injured because I fell off my bike.

target: Dokter bilang saya harus istirahat tiga hari.
english: The doctor said I have to rest for three days.
grammar: bilang = say, the conversational verb: Dokter bilang... = The doctor said...

target: Apakah ada apotek dekat hotel ini?
english: Is there a pharmacy near this hotel?

target: Saya mencari obat untuk sakit kepala.
english: I am looking for medicine for a headache.

target: Jangan lupa minum obat tiga kali sehari.
english: Don't forget to take your medicine three times a day.
grammar: kali = times: tiga kali sehari = three times a day.

target: Dia sedang istirahat di kamar karena demam.
english: She is resting in her room because of a fever.

target: Mata saya lelah karena bekerja di depan komputer.
english: My eyes are tired from working in front of the computer.

target: Ayah pergi ke rumah sakit untuk periksa kesehatan.
english: Dad went to the hospital for a health check-up.
grammar: ke-...-an builds nouns: sehat (healthy) becomes kesehatan (health).

target: Perawat itu memeriksa tekanan darah saya.
english: The nurse checked my blood pressure.

target: Setelah minum obat, dia merasa lebih baik.
english: After taking the medicine, she felt better.

target: Tangan saya sakit setelah mengangkat kotak berat.
english: My arm hurts after lifting heavy boxes.

target: Saya batuk terus sejak dua hari lalu.
english: I have been coughing constantly since two days ago.
grammar: terus after a verb = keeps on: batuk terus = keeps coughing.

target: Kalau masih demam besok, pergi ke dokter, ya.
english: If you still have a fever tomorrow, go to the doctor, okay.

target: Punggung saya sakit karena duduk terlalu lama.
english: My back hurts from sitting too long.

target: Dia alergi obat itu, jadi hati-hati.
english: He is allergic to that medicine, so be careful.

target: Saya mau membuat janji dengan dokter gigi.
english: I want to make an appointment with the dentist.
grammar: membuat janji = make an appointment; janji alone means promise.

target: Anak itu menangis karena giginya sakit.
english: That child is crying because his tooth hurts.

target: Minum air putih yang banyak supaya cepat sembuh.
english: Drink lots of water so you get better quickly.
grammar: supaya = so that: supaya cepat sembuh = so you recover fast.

target: Kepala saya pusing kalau kurang tidur.
english: I get dizzy when I don't get enough sleep.

target: Dokter memberi saya resep obat baru.
english: The doctor gave me a prescription for new medicine.

target: Anak-anak menyikat gigi sebelum tidur.
english: The children brush their teeth before bed.

target: Badan saya panas, mungkin saya demam.
english: My body feels hot, maybe I have a fever.
grammar: mungkin = maybe: Mungkin saya demam. = Maybe I have a fever.

target: Dia dirawat di rumah sakit selama tiga hari.
english: He was treated in the hospital for three days.

target: Saya minta izin pulang cepat karena sakit.
english: I asked permission to go home early because I am sick.
grammar: minta izin = ask permission: minta izin pulang = ask to leave early.

target: Olahraga setiap pagi membuat badan sehat.
english: Exercising every morning keeps the body healthy.

target: Hidung saya tersumbat karena pilek.
english: My nose is blocked because of a cold.

target: Kakek saya jalan pelan-pelan karena kakinya sakit.
english: My grandpa walks slowly because his leg hurts.

target: Semoga kamu cepat sembuh dan sehat kembali.
english: I hope you get well soon and are healthy again.
grammar: Semoga = I hope: Semoga cepat sembuh. = Hope you get better soon.

target: Saya tidak bisa tidur karena batuk semalaman.
english: I could not sleep because I was coughing all night.

target: Perawat itu sangat ramah kepada pasien.
english: That nurse is very friendly to the patients.

target: Obat ini harus diminum setelah makan.
english: This medicine must be taken after eating.
grammar: di- flips the verb passive: diminum = is taken (drunk).

target: Dia terjatuh di tangga dan kakinya luka.
english: He fell on the stairs and injured his leg.

target: Saya periksa mata di klinik minggu lalu.
english: I had my eyes checked at a clinic last week.

target: Istirahat dulu, pekerjaan bisa menunggu besok.
english: Rest first, the work can wait until tomorrow.

target: Telinga saya sakit setelah berenang di kolam.
english: My ear hurts after swimming in the pool.

target: Dia minum vitamin setiap pagi supaya tidak mudah sakit.
english: She takes vitamins every morning so she doesn't get sick easily.

target: Kalau capek, jangan lupa istirahat sebentar.
english: If you are tired, don't forget to rest for a bit.

target: Terima kasih, saya sudah merasa jauh lebih baik.
english: Thank you, I already feel much better.
